shortDescription: Manage packages on SUSE and openSUSE

options.name: allow_vendor_change
options.description: Adds C(--allow_vendor_change) option to I(zypper) dist-upgrade command.

options.name: auto_import_keys
options.description: Whether to automatically import new repository signing keys. Adds C(--gpg-auto-import-keys) option to I(zypper). Is only used when installing.

options.name: clean_deps
options.description: Adds C(--clean-deps) option to I(zypper) remove command.

options.name: disable_gpg_check
options.description: Whether to disable to GPG signature checking of the package signature being installed. Has an effect only if O(state) is V(present) or V(latest).

options.name: disable_recommends
options.description: Corresponds to the C(--no-recommends) option for I(zypper). Default behavior (V(true)) modifies zypper's default behavior; V(false) does install recommended packages.

options.name: extra_args
options.description: Add additional options to C(zypper) command. Options should be supplied in a single line as if given in the command line.

options.name: extra_args_precommand
options.description: Add additional global target options to C(zypper). Options should be supplied in a single line as if given in the command line.

options.name: force
options.description: Adds C(--force) option to I(zypper). Allows to downgrade packages and change vendor or architecture.

options.name: force_resolution
options.description: Adds C(--force-resolution) option to I(zypper). Allows to (un)install packages with conflicting requirements (resolver chooses a solution).

options.name: name
options.description: Package name V(name) or package specifier or a list of either. Can include a version like V(name=1.0), V(name>3.4) or V(name<=2.7). If a version is given, V(oldpackage) is implied and zypper is allowed to update the package within the version range given. You can also pass a URL or a local path to a rpm file. When using O(state=latest), this can be V(*), which updates all installed packages.

options.name: oldpackage
options.description: Adds C(--oldpackage) option to I(zypper). Allows to downgrade packages with less side-effects than force. This is implied as soon as a version is specified as part of the package name.

options.name: quiet
options.description: Adds C(--quiet) option to I(zypper) install/update command.

options.name: replacefiles
options.description: Adds C(--replacefiles) option to I(zypper) install/update command.

options.name: simple_errors
options.description: When set to V(true), provide a simplified error output (parses only the C(<message>) tag text in the XML output).

options.name: skip_post_errors
options.description: When set to V(true), ignore I(zypper) return code 107 (post install script errors).

options.name: state
options.description: V(present) makes sure the package is installed. V(latest) makes sure the latest version of the package is installed. V(absent) makes sure the specified package is not installed. V(dist-upgrade) makes sure the latest version of all installed packages from all enabled repositories is installed. When using V(dist-upgrade), O(name) should be V(*).

options.name: type
options.description: The type of package to be operated on.

options.name: update_cache
options.description: Run the equivalent of C(zypper refresh) before the operation. Disabled in check mode.
